P.name: Short Fuse
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Ziggs''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to deal {{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +8*x for 6; then +12*x for 8|formula = 16 + 4 per level up to 6, then + 8 per level up to 12, then + 12 per level up to 18}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}},{{ft|increased by 75% against {{tip|structures}}.|increased to {{as|{{pp|1.75*(20+4*(x-1)) for 6;then +1.75*8*x for 6;then +1.75*12*x for 8|formula={{ap|20*1.75}} + {{ap|4*1.75}} per level up to 6, then + {{ap|8*1.75}} per level up to level 12, then + {{ap|12*1.75}} per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.75}}% AP)}} against {{tip|structures}}.}}
P.description2: ''Short Fuse's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by {{pp|4 to 6 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds whenever '''Ziggs''' casts an {{tip|ability}}.

Q.name: Bouncing Bomb
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' throws a bomb to the target location that bounces forward up to two times, with the distance traveled each time being based on how far it was originally thrown and each bounce occurring over {{fd|0.495}} seconds regardless of distance.
Q.description2: The bomb explodes upon landing near an enemy, within terrain, or the final bounce, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.

W.name: Satchel Charge
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.
W.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ziggs''' detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} over {{fd|0.5}} seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will {{tip|dash}} up to 825 units away from the center.
W.description3: {{cci|Satchel Charge Turret Explosion Indicator.png|border=false||{{sbc|Turret Explosion:}}}} The explosion also {{ccs|{{tip|execute|executes}}|magic}} enemy {{tip|turrets}} within that are below a {{as|'''maximum''' health}} threshold.
W.description4: '''''Ziggs''' will not {{tip|dash}} from the explosion if he is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

E.name: Hexplosive Minefield
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' scatters a cluster of 11 proximity mines over the target location that grant {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds, {{tt|arming after {{fd|0.5}} seconds|travel time of the mines spreading out plus a brief delay}} and lasting for up to 10 seconds.
E.description2: Each mine within the area explodes upon contact with terrain or an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around the explosion for 2 seconds. An enemy takes 40% damage from subsequent mines.

R.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ziggs''' catapults the ''Mega Inferno Bomb'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 4 seconds.
R.description2: The bomb explodes upon arrival to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced to 65% against those outside of the epicenter.
R.leveling2: {{st|Epicenter Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700|round=2}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300*0.65 to 700*0.65}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.65}}% AP)}}}}
